h1: Crypto payments for gaming & iGaming platforms with zero chargeback risk
subheading: Accept 15+ cryptocurrencies from players worldwide, eliminate payment friction, and receive funds directly to your wallet—no intermediaries.
intro_paragraph: Gaming and iGaming operators face constant payment challenges: card processors block or restrict accounts, chargebacks drain revenue, and players in restricted regions cannot deposit. DynoPay is a non-custodial platform that lets you accept Bitcoin, Ethereum, USDT, and 12+ other cryptocurrencies. You receive funds directly in your wallet—DynoPay never holds your money—and payments settle instantly with fees starting at 1.5% that drop to 0.5% at scale. No chargebacks. No blocks. No monthly fees.

features.title: Zero chargeback exposure
features.description: Crypto transactions are final. Players cannot reverse deposits after losing, protecting your revenue from fraudulent disputes that cost traditional processors 0.5–2% of volume annually.

features.title: Serve players in any country
features.description: Accept payments globally without geographic restrictions. No need to maintain multiple processor relationships or navigate country-specific banking regulations—crypto works everywhere by default.

features.title: Direct wallet settlements
features.description: Receive funds straight to your Ethereum, Bitcoin, or USDT wallet within minutes. DynoPay never holds your money, so you maintain full custody and can access capital immediately.

how_it_works: Sign up, verify your email, and create your company profile in under three minutes.
Add your Bitcoin, Ethereum, or stablecoin wallet address where you want to receive player deposits.
Generate payment links or embed the checkout widget on your platform and start accepting crypto.

faqs.question: Do crypto payments for gaming have chargebacks?
faqs.answer: No. Cryptocurrency transactions are irreversible by design. Once a player sends a deposit, they cannot dispute or reverse it, eliminating chargeback fraud and the 0.5–2% loss traditional gaming operators face from card disputes.

faqs.question: What cryptocurrencies can gaming platforms accept with DynoPay?
faqs.answer: DynoPay supports 15+ cryptocurrencies including Bitcoin, Ethereum, Litecoin, Dogecoin, USDT on Ethereum, Polygon and Tron, USDC, SOL, XRP, RLUSD, and others. Players choose their preferred coin at checkout.

faqs.question: How much does DynoPay charge for gaming crypto payments?
faqs.answer: Fees start at 1.5% plus one dollar per transaction and automatically drop to 0.5% as your settled volume grows. No monthly fees, no setup costs, and your first payment is completely free. No chargebacks mean no dispute fees.

faqs.question: Can I accept crypto from players in restricted countries?
faqs.answer: Yes. DynoPay has no geographic restrictions for receiving cryptocurrency payments. Players anywhere can deposit without country blocks. KYC requirements apply only if you convert crypto to fiat through an off-ramp partner in certain jurisdictions.

faqs.question: How quickly can a gaming site start accepting crypto with DynoPay?
faqs.answer: Most operators go live in under 10 minutes. Sign up, verify your email, add your payout wallet address, and generate a payment link or embed the checkout widget. No lengthy approvals or compliance holds.

cta_body: Your first payment is free. No monthly fees, no setup costs, and live in under 10 minutes with zero chargeback risk.
